description: §7.3.5 clean neg — no W-UNUSED-BINDING: every local is read (`base` only by a later initializer, `total` by its own reassignment and after it, `x` in the loop body), the unread `_skipped` and `_item` are exempt by their `_` prefix, and an unread parameter is not a binding the lint covers.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — unused-binding lint code: W-UNUSED-BINDING (S479, 2026-11-18)" ("a `_` prefix exempts it")
rationale: §7.3.5: "a name beginning with `_` is exempt"; "A reference counts wherever it stands in the scope: … in the initializer of a later binding"; parameters are listed as not covered.
